table.description: Literal-pool float (stoich AFR 14.7), referenced by a mova in the fuel-correction/catalyst model (FUN_0003e560 in 60E15120_N3J1E, PID 0x3c path): diag_afr_word_a * fVar4 * 14.7. Converts lambda-domain fueling to AFR. NOT the base injection map (that is tbl 0x6ac88 + open-loop target 0x69e9c). Editing changes fuel correction + AFR display; this address is inside the app-flash checksum range (D3, 0x2000-0x7ffff) - bench-validate before flashing (AGENTS.md rule 10). See calibration_extraction_report.md 6a. ROM address 0x40f9c, value 14.699999809265137 (asserted against ROM bytes by this script).
